text: Emergency lighting shall give at least 1 lux (at floor level) on escape routes and 5 lux at fire-fighting and first-aid equipment for 90 minutes (EL-DBR-0001 section 14) from the UPS / battery; escape and exit signs shall be photoluminescent or illuminated; the emergency response plan (HS-PLN-0005) shall define at least two assembly points, wind socks visible from all process areas, safety showers, first-aid stations and the fire station response.
